content.title: High-Speed Pursuit Reframe | Carrier, Giant Threat, Blast Survival
content.summary: A salt courier escapes a harvesting machine through a sand-plume reframe. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult rider and one vehicle remain identity anchors. + The pursuing scale threat enters established geography. + Every obstacle changes the route rather than decorating it. + One evasive action remains spatially readable. + The terminal wide shot proves survival with the original carrier.
quick_start.recommended_input: Track one adult salt-flat courier riding a white electric sled along a red beacon line. Force the courier beside one broken turbine blade while dust compresses the route. Burst one bounded sand plume, then reveal the same sled departing beyond it with beacon and machine still locatable.
required_anchors: One adult rider and one vehicle remain identity anchors.
The pursuing scale threat enters established geography.
One evasive action remains spatially readable.

usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A salt courier escapes a harvesting machine through a sand-plume reframe. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.

not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
